head: HEAD
description: Review the bundled demo shop's user-visible cart and checkout behavior. Exercise adding a widget and completing an ordinary purchase. Also examine the expired-card path, which the repository describes as a known defect, while distinguishing an expected payment rejection from an unrelated application or browser failure.

journeys.title: Add a widget to the cart
journeys.goal: add one widget and inspect the cart
journeys.because: the repository's shop flow requires the selected product and total to be visible

state: The application state was reset before this journey

steps.see: The Shop page offers a Product selector, Quantity input, and Add to cart button.

steps.do: Choose widget with quantity 1 and add it to the cart.
steps.see: The Your cart page shows 1 x widget and Total: 1000 cents.

journeys.title: Complete a purchase with a valid card
journeys.persona: A shopper ready to purchase a widget
journeys.goal: complete checkout with a valid card
journeys.because: the repository protects successful checkout and its order confirmation

state: The application state was reset before this journey

steps.do: Open the shop UI at /ui and add one widget to the cart.
steps.see: The Your cart page shows 1 x widget and Total: 1000 cents.

steps.do: Choose the valid card and place the order.
steps.see: The page shows Order confirmed and an Order reference.

journeys.title: Expired card explains the rejection and preserves the cart
journeys.persona: A shopper whose saved card has expired
journeys.goal: understand the rejection and retry without rebuilding the cart
journeys.because: the repository marks the generic message and cleared cart as deliberate defects

state: The application state was reset before this journey

steps.do: Open the shop UI at /ui and add one widget to the cart.
steps.see: The Your cart page shows 1 x widget and Total: 1000 cents.

steps.do: Choose the expired card and place the order once, then stop without resubmitting.
steps.see: The alert tells the shopper that the card is expired.

steps.do: Inspect the cart after the rejected payment.
steps.see: The cart still shows 1 x widget and Total: 1000 cents so the shopper can retry.

journeys.traces_to: ui.py ui_checkout expired branch; e2e/test_shop_flows.py::test_checkout_with_expired_card_preserves_cart; README.md deliberate defects

sources.app.py: Actual FastAPI application, /health and /reset behavior, and checkout API contract.
sources.ui.py: Actual /ui controls, visible cart text, and valid/expired checkout behavior.
sources.e2e/test_shop_flows.py: Repository-authored widget, valid-card, and expired-card behavioral expectations.
sources.../README.md: Documents the demo UI and its deliberate expired-card defects.
